premise: Butterfly cannot decide which flower to land on and flutters over the meadow all day; Bee says just try one; the first one Butterfly tries is perfect.
inspiration: Buridan's donkey between two haystacks (folk paradox), turned gentle: no one goes hungry, and trying beats choosing.
lesson: You can't find the right one until you try one.

en-US.title: Butterfly Cannot Choose
en-US.text: {flower:sway loop 0.4} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} The meadow was full of flowers. Pink ones, blue ones, yellow ones with freckles. Butterfly {butterfly:float loop 0.6} floated over them all. Which one? Which one? The pink one is pretty. But the blue one is bluer. But the yellow one has freckles! Butterfly {butterfly:wobble x3} flittered left. Flittered right. Went round in a circle. Up went the sun. Across went the sun. Butterfly was still deciding. Bee {bee:hop} landed on the yellow one. Slurp. Delicious. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} sat on the blue one. Lovely and cool. Butterfly? said Bee. Butterfly was making a list. Just try one, said Bee. Any one. So Butterfly {butterfly:hop} landed. On the first flower they came to. Big and pink and warm from the whole day of sun. {flower:pulse} {flower:sparkle} Oh, said Butterfly. Oh, it's perfect. {butterfly:hearts} Which one? asked Ladybug. This one, said Butterfly. And they never even looked at the others.

es-ES.title: Mariposa no sabe elegir
es-ES.text: {flower:sway loop 0.4} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} El prado estaba lleno de flores. Rosas, azules, amarillas con pecas. Mariposa {butterfly:float loop 0.6} flotaba por encima de todas. ¿Cuál? ¿Cuál? La rosa es bonita. Pero la azul es más azul. ¡Pero la amarilla tiene pecas! Mariposa {butterfly:wobble x3} revoloteó a la izquierda. A la derecha. Dio una vuelta entera. El sol subió. El sol cruzó el cielo. Mariposa seguía decidiendo. Abeja {bee:hop} se posó en la amarilla. Ñam. Riquísima. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} se sentó en la azul. Fresquita y suave. ¿Mariposa?, dijo Abeja. Mariposa estaba haciendo una lista. Prueba una, dijo Abeja. Cualquiera. Y Mariposa {butterfly:hop} se posó. En la primera flor que encontró. Grande, rosa y calentita de todo un día de sol. {flower:pulse} {flower:sparkle} Oh, dijo Mariposa. Oh, es perfecta. {butterfly:hearts} ¿Cuál?, preguntó Mariquita. Esta, dijo Mariposa. Y ya no miró ninguna otra.
